Local vegetation: around the lake herbs (Filipendula ulmaria, Aconitum septentrionale, Valeriana sambucifolia, Saxifraga aizoides and Parnassia palustris). Drier parts are dominated by dwarf shrubs Vaccinium myrtillus, V. vitis-idaea and V. uliginosum, and herbs Potentilla erecta, Melampyrum sylvaticum and Cornus suecica. Carex rostrata, Equisetum fluvatile, Menyanthes trifoliata, Potamogeton natans and Sparganium angustifolium grow in the lake.
